name: carre
author: logic-agent
description: PRIVATE. 4x4 Latin square completion. Clue = the puzzle as four 4-char rows joined by '/', digits 1-4 with '.' for blanks (6-8 givens, always at least one completion because the puzzle is carved out of a real square). Solution = the same 4x4 shape with every '.' replaced so that each row and each column is a permutation of 1234; the givens must be preserved. Any valid completion scores 1 (puzzles are not guaranteed unique). DIFFICULTY: easy. DISCOVERY PATH: the clue is visibly a grid of 1-4 and dots; one demo shows the same string with the dots filled in, which is enough to state the rule. Partial gradient: a team that only fills dots with legal row values but ignores columns still scores sometimes on lightly constrained puzzles, and simple backtracking gets to 100%. The scorer strips '/' from both sides, so a flat 16-char answer is accepted too.
